Basics

Beet spread

Céklakrém

8 months+ Sound idea 30 min 4 portions

From 8 months, as a small spread rather than a large bowl every day. Beet can stay on the menu within that limit.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 50 g cooked beet (boiled or baked until soft, then peeled)
  • 80 g cooked potato (peeled)
  • 1 tsp rapeseed or olive oil (no salt)

Allergens

none

Method

  1. Boil or bake the beet and potato until both are soft.
  2. Peel and chop them.
  3. Blend with the oil and a splash of cooking water.
  4. Stop while the spread is soft enough to spoon.
  5. Serve a small amount and add no salt.

Sound idea

Beet is rich in nitrate, so offer a spread rather than a huge daily portion. This is a limit, not a ban.

Blend cooked beet and potato with oil and no salt.
